t: Add rate limiting middleware to public endpoints
body:
Adds a token-bucket limiter in front of the public routes.

## What changed
- New `middleware.RateLimit` keyed by API token (falls back to client IP)
- Limits come from `RATE_LIMIT_RPS` / `RATE_LIMIT_BURST`
- Responds `429` with a `Retry-After` header

## Testing
- [x] Unit tests for the bucket refill
- [x] Manual run with `hey -n 2000 -c 50`
- [ ] Load test on staging

Closes #431.

t: Fix focus trap in modal dialogs
body:
Focus escaped the dialog when the last control was disabled.

The trap now skips disabled elements and restores focus to the opener on close.

t: Switch telemetry batching to an async channel
body:
Replaces the mutex-guarded `Vec` with a bounded `tokio::sync::mpsc` channel.

Draft: benchmarks still to come.
`repo list --json name,stars` mirrors the other list commands.
Sources the generated completion lazily so shell startup stays fast.
Bumps actions/checkout from 4 to 5.

t: Reconcile pending entries in a single transaction
body: Fixes double-posting when two reconcilers race.

Replaces offset pagination with opaque cursors.

Still to do: docs and a migration note.

body:

t: Retry flaky upload step with backoff
body: Retries the upload up to 4 times with exponential backoff and jitter.
Groups the key bindings and drops unused plugins.
Unknown versions used to fall through to v1.

t: Timeout on /v2/search with large result sets
body:
Queries matching more than 10k rows hit the 30s gateway timeout.

Repro: `GET /v2/search?q=language:go&per_page=100`.
